name: Megalodon
role: The big show. Huge, fast for its size, always moving.
habit: Never stops. Passes close to every seat row once per lap. Small fish scatter in front of it.
rules: Bosses own the stage: no big fish, the big-fish clock waits.
Mediums only as escorts; small fish keep 0.15 away from the boss.
The boss spends equal time near top, bottom, left and right seats.
It never leaves before the scene ends (minus 4 s).
Charges come with a 1 s warning shadow.
